# Copilot instructions

Read [`.claude/CLAUDE.md`](../.claude/CLAUDE.md) for the canonical project guidance and [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) for the concise rules.

For every change, preserve the SvelteKit static-site architecture, use Bun-backed scripts, avoid editing generated `build/` output, avoid unnecessary Alko API calls, and keep sync/migration hashes compatible. Discontinued products must remain in the dataset with lifecycle metadata rather than being deleted. Keep UI copy in Finnish and use the typed local-storage helpers.
